You are working inside the cassava-cafe-portal project.

This is a modern cafe management, showcase the history of the cafe, view the menu, and admin can manage the menu. The project is built using React + Typescript

## UI/UX Principles

- Mobile-first responsive design
- Information must be scannable within 3–5 seconds
- Strong visual hierarchy
- Accessible semantic HTML
- Spacious layout with good typography and spacing
- Prioritize readability over complexity

## Technical Stack

- React + TypeScript
- Functional components only
- Tailwind CSS only
- shadcn/ui components when appropriate
- No external UI libraries

## Architecture Rules

- Separate: pages, sections, components, hooks, and mock data
- Keep components single responsibility
- Use reusable section/container patterns
- Store mock/static data separately
- Page components should be mostly compositional
- Avoid unnecessary state and inline styles
- Avoid monolithic components

## Code Quality Standards

- Production-ready code
- Clean and readable naming
- Minimal but scalable abstractions
- Prefer simplicity over overengineering
- Senior-engineer level expectations
